name: Shinjou Yukina
source: A strange girl that appears on campus at nighttime. Always doing what she wants, quiet and emotionless girl, no one knows what is in her heart and mind. Sometimes she will show a stupid side that leaves people speechless. Clear about her likes and dislikes, if she likes something then she likes it, if she hates something she will express her disgust. She claims to be the protagonist's wife.
